That covered the probe `printf`, the first `tester do ex_1 - goto '/'` and its one allowed retry, and the Write of `tester.report.md`. No browser action ran and no report exists. The guard did block every call. The Tester's claim that the hook crashed on each one is only in its reply; I didn't check it against anything else.

**Record paths:** none. Ingest wrote no record for either Run (`record: null`, `tc_d68h3nc7` counted as not run, "no Execution ran and none was Blocked before dispatch").
- Own Run `8w8820zb`: `$TMPDIR/qa-skills-execute-Lyi3qs`, Execution `ex_1`
- Sibling Run `asbkmhb6`: `$TMPDIR/qa-skills-execute-WAe9o3`, Execution `ex_1`

**Factual problems:**

- **Sibling:** stayed idle with no Tester. Its `guard.json` now differs from `sibling-before.json` only by an added `"closed": true`, written at 10:33 when the Runs were ingested. `used` is still 0 and the log is empty. The later `execute close` calls on both Runs returned `closed: []`, so ingest had already closed them.

The only qa-skills registration enabled is `qa-skills@qa-trust-core-fault`; `qa-skills@qa-skills` and `qa-skills@qa-skills-local` are both false. User settings have no qa-skills entry, there is no project `settings.json`, managed settings and remote settings set no `enabledPlugins`, and the session has no `--settings` or `--plugin-dir` flag.
